description: Feuille de route FAIR: ensembles de données et ressources is a dataset listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by FAIR. This dataset provides the FAIR portal roadmap on datasets and resources by the healthdata.be (Sciensano) team. Coverage: FAIR. The portal shows the English title as "FAIR roadmap: datasets and resources" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is FAIR. Its keywords include 0db07e8b-cd63-5822-b104-0958dd620754, 00ccb52a-799e-5c0f-bc90-c4f9f0ad28f5, 085e9e74-42de-54bb-8a3d-0210d869d610, 90c4d9fe-0706-58fe-89ad-5489c09b5579, 18deaa07-84ff-589d-a844-9100aa10a0a2, 38f89e3a-a1af-5698-9876-f804d71a3745. The listing shows 1 download or service links in XLSX. The listing shows 2026-08-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Attribution License v1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
